layout.concept: Multi-workspace technical workstation with discrete per-workspace isolation (Workspace 1: Video, Workspace 2: Image, etc.), top telemetry and real hardware acceleration tier indicator bar, left-aligned minimal parameter controls, and an aesthetic top-right floating translucent Zen lockscreen button [ ⛶ ZEN ] / [ 🔒 LOCK ] to collapse all chrome into full-screen distraction-free viewing.
layout.alignment_rationale: Left-aligned workspace parameter drawers and top workspace tab selector with centered canvas viewport ensure rock-solid stability during real-time 60 FPS video and procedural stream switching without layout shift.

principles: Stripped of all colorful AI gradients, gimmicky mockup cards, and pastel badges, this interface operates as an authentic high-precision engineering console. Compartmentalized per-workspace isolation gives every video, image, and camera session dedicated execution lifecycles without canvas collisions. Deep obsidian graphite surfaces (#000000, #0a0a0c) paired with real hardware-detected telemetry and a surgical top-right Zen lockscreen button honor the user brief for strict black-and-white minimalism and zero-gimmick authenticity.

orchestrated_moment.justification: Exactly ONE 1.2s monochrome hardware-handshake entrance animation probes navigator.gpu and GPU device capabilities, reveals the active workspace container, and draws the primary parameter perimeter. Subsequent workspace switches and top-right Zen lockscreen collapse (200ms ease-out) remain crisp, low-overhead, and static.

tells_checked: Checked cream/terracotta tell: rejected warm-clay and paper tints in favor of deliberate pure black #000000 base and #ffffff white highlights.

Checked near-black/acid-green slop tell: user brief explicitly mandates monochrome B&W minimalism; deliberate override of color accents to pure monochrome #ffffff with subtle graphite elevation #0a0a0c.
Checked broadsheet layout tell: rejected hairline newspaper columns; structured as high-density multi-workspace technical workstation with tabbed workspace isolation.

Checked SaaS card kit tell: eliminated uniform rounded cards and soft shadows; used sharp 2px-4px borders, isolated workspace views, real hardware tier telemetry badges, and an aesthetic top-right floating translucent Zen lock pill.
Checked template chrome: removed tracked-out ALL-CAPS eyebrows, middot separators, and arrow CTA suffixes; used clean sentence-case and monospace readouts.
Checked AI-slop colorful gradients: completely purged rainbow badges and purple-to-blue neon glows in favor of deliberate monochrome luminance mapping and authentic hardware status indicators.

Checked blanket transitions tell: restricted motion to exactly ONE startup reveal moment (1.2s monochrome boot sequence) and a 200ms ease-out Zen lockscreen collapse; all tab switches and parameter adjustments use instant mechanical updates.
